proposal.hypothesis: The search is stagnant with no improvement and high residual correlation, suggesting the current operator set is insufficient to capture the underlying structure. Adding the tanh operator may introduce the nonlinearity needed to reduce residual correlation and improve the model.
proposal.falsification: If adding tanh does not improve the validation NRMSE or scientific score within a few rounds, or if it leads to overfitting (increased complexity without score gain), the hypothesis is falsified.
